category_title: Students who display hostility toward diversity-related course content
minimal_context: The student is participating in a classroom discussion where the professor has introduced diversity-related initiatives.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Today we are going to have a classroom discussion to introduce our new diversity-related initiatives.

STUDENT: I openly express my disagreement with the idea that we should embrace diversity.

TUTOR: Please explain your thoughts on the topic.

STUDENT: Diversity applied within the context of religion and morality evokes strong emotions for me.

TUTOR: We still need to continue talking about embracing diversity for this lesson.

STUDENT: (Gets up and walks out) I am not staying for this. I will sort of storm out whenever we are talking about embracing diversity!

options.A: Request that all questions be held until the end of the class discussion.
options.B: Praise the student's positive behavior as a component of proactive and preventive classroom management.
options.C: Maintain a high ratio of praise statements to error correction statements during the class discussion.
options.D: Implement a personalized intervention focused on instructing a replacement behavior with functionally relevant reinforcers.
